blockers.where: Speakeasy setup — "Operator lookup result: the Speakeasy MCP Catalog is absent"
blockers.problem: The Dossier records catalog absence even though the supplied operator note says the Custom remote path is forced because the catalog mapping is unreliable or unsuitable.
blockers.suggestion: Replace the catalog-absence claim with the override rationale, retain only the Custom remote path, and keep `speakeasy_add_server: custom-remote` in Metadata.

blockers.problem: The Setup Guide omits the Dossier's requirement that users of an Internal OAuth audience belong to the Google Workspace organization associated with the project.
blockers.suggestion: State before audience selection that Internal is suitable only when every intended user belongs to the project's associated Google Workspace organization; otherwise select External and add those users as test users.

blockers.problem: The guide requires Google Workspace Developer Preview Program access but provides no path to obtain or verify that access before attempting the first connection.
